description: Macao's Statistics and Census Service runs an interactive census database for the 2011 and 2021 censuses and the 2016 by-census, with a JSON API behind it that the web application calls without registration. The housing dataset cross tabulates units by parish and statistical district with type of housing (private, economic or social), tenure, mortgage and rent bands, the starting year of occupancy of the building (before 1980 to 2010 and after), usable area of the unit, household size, composition and earnings. Separate datasets cover residents, labour and households. Coverage is the whole territory: a query of the 2021 housing dataset by parish returned 201,817 units, 79,837 of them in Nossa Senhora de Fátima. Format and access: free; the metadata endpoint answers a GET and the data endpoint a POST naming dimensions, filters and year; the census 2021 website is a JavaScript application, and a statistical GIS shows figures by statistical unit. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the API is undocumented and meant for the web application; dimension names in the data query differ from those in the 2021 metadata; the unit counted in the housing dataset is not named in the responses. Simulation uses: district level building age and unit size for exposure and densification studies in a dense city. Related records: the DSOP Macao public works list.
